description: This file defines a validation rule class 'MyTimesheetActionRule' used in the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends a generic AbstractRule and implements a validate method that checks if the input action is valid based on the TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP in TimesheetService.

classes.name: MyTimesheetActionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given timesheet action input is valid.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input string is contained within the TIMESHEET_ACTION_MAP.
